_README: blocklist read by scripts/privacy-gate.mjs before every publish.
NEVER commit the real file. It names real people and this repo is public.
Copy this file to ~/.project_ledger/private-filter.json on the build host and
fill it in there. The gate warns and publishes unfiltered if it is missing.
Matching is word-boundary, case-insensitive, applied to the rendered TEXT of
each unit (a Done-tab <li>, a Front Page card, an Isa row, or one segment of
the audit footer). A unit that matches is removed whole.
blockTerms: // Hard block. Any unit naming one of these is removed, no matter the context.
// Use for people who should never appear in the ledger at all.
allowTerms: // Rescues legitimate collisions. Checked FIRST — these names are erased from
// the text before block matching, so a blocked first name cannot eat a longer
// name that contains it. Put every business counterparty who collides here.
contextTerms: // Soft block: people who legitimately appear in business items but whose
// personal threads must not. Removed only when the same unit also carries a
// personalMarker below — so a board intro survives and a family dispute does not.
personalMarkers: // The markers that turn a contextTerm into a block. Tune from real leaks.
blockCardIds: // fp-* / act-* card ids from the leaked matter. Belt-and-braces: catches the
// audit footer's '(fp-…)' provenance tails even when the prose was reworded.
